description:
`DrmCode::systematic_form` reimplements Gaussian elimination over a bit matrix when the core crate already provides the identical operation. Replace the hand-rolled elimination with the shared routine and keep only the logic that is genuinely DRM-specific.

## Background

The reimplementation sits at `crates/gf2-coding/src/drm.rs:624`. The core routine `gf2_core::alg::rref::rref` with right-pivoting disabled performs the same reduction. What the DRM path adds beyond the reduction is the column rearrangement that follows it, which stays.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `DrmCode::systematic_form` obtains its reduced form from the shared core RREF routine rather than from elimination code written in this module.
- [hard] REQ-02: The post-reduction column-rearrangement logic is retained and continues to produce the same systematic ordering.
- [hard] REQ-03: No Gaussian-elimination loop remains in `drm.rs`.
- [hard] REQ-04: DRM encode and decode results are unchanged across the crate's existing DRM tests.
- [hard] REQ-05: The workspace test suite, clippy with warnings denied, and formatting all pass.
title: Route DrmCode::systematic_form through the core RREF routine
